# Common Expenses Tracker

> Free browser-based calculators for splitting bills, budgeting, tracking recurring
> bills, and planning savings goals. No sign-up, no backend — all data stays in
> localStorage on the visitor's device.

## Calculators
- [Split Expense](https://common-expenses-tracker.vercel.app/split): Split a bill among a group and see who owes who, with automatic settle-up.
- [Budget Tracker](https://common-expenses-tracker.vercel.app/budget): Log income and expenses by category with a running balance.
- [Recurring Bills](https://common-expenses-tracker.vercel.app/bills): Track subscriptions and bills, see upcoming due dates and true monthly total.
- [Savings Goal](https://common-expenses-tracker.vercel.app/savings): Set a target and timeline, get the required monthly savings amount.
